about: data.norge.no (Felles datakatalog) is Norway's national data portal. This CLI searches and looks up datasets, APIs (data services), concepts, information models, public services/events and publishing organizations through the portal's public JSON APIs.

commands.summary: Quick title suggestions (top 10 matching resources of any type) for a search term
Natural-language AI search over the catalog metadata (e.g. 'Hvor mange bor i Oslo'); returns the most relevant resources

params.name: query
params.description: Natural-language question. Do not include personal or sensitive data.

commands.summary: Get full metadata for a dataset by id (JSON via the resource service): description, distributions, themes, publisher, contact
Get full metadata for an API (data service) by id (JSON via the resource service): endpoint URLs, documentation, formats, publisher

params.name: id
params.description: Data service id (UUID from search results)

commands.summary: Get a concept (term definition) by id: preferred labels, definition and sources, remarks, subject, related concepts, publisher
Get the raw RDF (Turtle) description of a dataset or data service, exactly as harvested
List publishing organizations with org number, orgPath and counts of datasets, concepts, APIs and information models

params.name: includeEmpty
params.description: Include organizations that have published nothing

commands.summary: Get an organization's profile by org number: details plus counts of datasets (open, authoritative, quality score), APIs, concepts and information models
List EU data theme codes and labels, for the dataTheme filter
List the LOS (Norwegian public sector) themes and words with paths and synonyms, for the losTheme filter
